title: The Ceiling a Ridgecrest RxSecure Penalty Relief Is Held To
content:
A relief of late enrollment penalty on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is held to a ceiling read off the member's premium account, and the ceiling is worked out differently according to the standing of the enrollment and the number of penalty charges the account carries.

**Where the enrollment stands in its premium grace period and 2 or more penalty charges stand on the premium account**, the ceiling is worked out by totalling the penalty the account has charged since coverage began and taking off every removal already posted.

**Where the enrollment stands in force and 2 or more penalty charges stand on the premium account**, the ceiling is worked out by totalling the penalty charged in the 6 months up to the handling date and taking off every removal already posted.

**Where neither holds**, the ceiling is taken from the single latest penalty charge the premium account carries.

| Standing of the enrollment | Penalty charges on the account | How the ceiling is worked out |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In its premium grace period | 2 or more | every penalty charged since coverage began, less every removal already posted |
| In force | 2 or more | the penalty charged in the 6 months up to the handling date, less every removal already posted |
| In its premium grace period | 1 | the single latest penalty charge |
| In force | 1 | the single latest penalty charge |
| Terminated, or standing on any other footing | any | the single latest penalty charge |

Both parts of the first two rows must hold together. An enrollment standing in its premium grace period with only 1 penalty charge on the account falls to the last rows, as does an enrollment in force with only 1.

## Worked on a hypothetical account

Take an account carrying penalty charges of a hypothetical 4.40 USD, 4.40 USD and 3.20 USD, of which the last two fall in the 6 months up to the handling date, and one removal already posted of 2.00 USD.

- With the enrollment in its premium grace period, the total charged since coverage began is 12.00 USD, less the 2.00 USD already removed, giving a ceiling of 10.00 USD.
- With the enrollment in force, the penalty charged in the 6 months up to the handling date is 7.60 USD, less the 2.00 USD already removed, giving a ceiling of 5.60 USD.
- With only the latest of those charges standing on the account, the ceiling is that single charge of 3.20 USD.
